support_scope.protocol_scope: full faithful Java behavior and compatibility scope; platform narrowing does not remove protocol work
support_scope.later_enablement_rule: A reserved row becomes supported only through an explicit reviewed tracker change with pinned toolchains, a native executor, complete applicable commands, current native evidence, and updated downstream release gates.

cell_contract.c000_rule: Every applicable cell of every initially supported row requires current passing native EV evidence or reviewed non-applicability. Deferred, unavailable, unrun, stale, failed, or unapproved applicable cells block C000.14 and C000.V. Cross-build or emulation never substitutes for native evidence.

native_resource.reason: C000 introduces no native allocation, handle, lifetime, cleanup, or failure surface; the Rust workspace forbids unsafe code and adopts no native library
native_resource.reopen_condition: any native dependency, unsafe code, OS resource ownership, or native handle surface is introduced

ffi.reason: C000 introduces no foreign-function boundary, linked native library, generated binding, or cross-language in-process call
ffi.reopen_condition: any FFI declaration, generated binding, native link, or in-process foreign call is introduced

packaging.reason: C000 defines architecture governance and behavior-neutral verification tooling but no distributable binary, archive, image, installer, or release artifact
packaging.reopen_condition: a C000-produced distributable or release artifact is introduced

smoke.reason: C000 has no node or service runtime surface to start, probe, and stop; executable C000 tooling is covered by focused unit and eight-case differential cells
smoke.reopen_condition: a C000 runtime process, node, service, or operator-facing executable surface is introduced

continuous_enforcement.rule: The validator resolves each EV/RV reference, verifies immutable hashes, freshness, revision, and native execution, derives readiness, and rejects completed gates with deferred, unavailable, unrun, stale, failed, or unapproved applicable cells on supported rows. Reserved later-enablement rows are outside C000 until explicitly promoted by reviewed tracker change.
